weight_text.atmosphere: How close the investigation's tested atmospheres (oxygen, pressure) are to the profile: 60% share of its rows inside the envelope + 40% nearness of its closest row
weight_text.data: Per-test data available in the unified table: min(1, test rows / 100)
weight_text.fuel: Fuel type: solid materials 1.0; smoke or aerosol from heated materials 0.6; liquid droplets or gas flames 0.4; ground analysis or unknown 0.2
weight_text.gravity: Flight data in microgravity 1.0; ground analysis or modelling 0.4 (no investigation has partial-gravity data)
weight_text.safety_area: Tagged prevention, detection or suppression (official Background text or record metadata): 1 if tagged, else 0
